title: Orchestration Patterns
summary: Apply orchestration patterns, configure parallel isolation, detect and resolve conflicts, manage agent lifecycles, and implement recovery in multi-agent workflows.

rows: Agent B waits for Agent A's explicit completion signal
Dependent tasks — B needs A's output
Agents run simultaneously on separate branches/workspaces
Independent tasks with no shared state
Orchestrator assigns to workers, aggregates results
Agents triggered by GitHub events (PR opened, issue created)

blocks.text: **Completion Signals:** Sequential agents MUST wait for an explicit signal — not a time delay. Missing a gate = agents working on incomplete inputs.
